text.description_html:
Omnia 914 Lever and Square Deadbolt Mortise Lockset

Undeniably alluring in design, this solid brass lever and square deadbolt mortise lockset will add a modern accent to any door. It is finished in satin chrome; and the square rose has concealed screw mounting (installation screws are hidden), for a very contemporary look.

Built to withstand heavy use, Omnia commercial grade, UL listed, fire rated, mortise locks combine precision engineering for security and durability with attractive designs. The roses feature concealed screw mounting.

Features of the Modern Mortise Lockset with Square Rose

  • Meets ADA accessibility requirements.
  • Solid Brass Levers and Trim
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.

Specifications for Omnia 914 Modern Door Lever:

  • Lever Length: 4-1/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose: 2-9/16" square
  • Doors Thickness: Optional, 1-3/4" - 2-1/4" Thick Doors (Contact us if doors are thicker)
  • Backset: 2-1/2"or 2-3/4"
  • Front: Adjustable armored steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid brass faceplate for all lock bodies, finished to match trim.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • Lock Cylinder: Standard "C" keyway supplied with two nickel silver keys.
  • Storeroom Function: Latchbolt operates by lever inside and by key outside. The outside lever is rigid. Auxiliary latchbolt deadlocks latchbolt.
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
